synopsis: AVxcelerate is listed among modular on-road ADAS tool chains with strong sensor and scenario tooling, and appears as a specialist sensor-simulation option in the highest-cost example chain [f8282, f9305]. The glossary expands that chain to include heavy-machine dynamics, dSPACE or NI benches, and cloud execution [f16167]. Chapter 6 reports vendor claims of HiL-ready camera image injection and radar frame rates greater than 30 frames per second, but the radar claim does not specify the hardware [f4569, f4935]. The corpus names the tool as Ansys AVxcelerate in Chapter 6 and Synopsys AVxcelerate in Chapter 11, without explaining the naming difference [f4569, f4935, f8282].

relations.note: Both place AURELION or AVxcelerate specialist sensor simulation in the highest-cost chain.
Glossary adds dynamics tools, benches, and cloud execution to the example chain.
HiL-ready camera image injection substantiates the described sensor-tooling strength.
Adds a vendor radar-performance claim, with hardware unspecified.
Vendor attribution differs: Ansys in Chapter 6 versus Synopsys in Chapter 11.
